_comment: Labeled panel for ct-fuzz iteration. label = ct | leaky | unknown. ct/leaky targets ground precision/recall; unknown targets are production-of-interest.

go.label: ct
go.rationale: documented constant-time copy; dst preallocated outside timed region

go.label: ct
go.rationale: Curve25519 X25519 in golang.org/x/crypto is constant-time by design

go.label: ct
go.rationale: SHA-256 with fixed-length input has data-independent timing

go.label: microarch
go.rationale: 256-entry table fits in L1; dudect cannot resolve sub-line cache effects — out of scope

go.label: unknown
go.rationale: Go 1.18+ uses constant-time nistec; older was variable-time

go.label: leaky
go.rationale: rsa.DecryptPKCS1v15 with rng=nil disables blinding — known variable-time

go.label: unknown
go.rationale: rsa.DecryptPKCS1v15 with blinding; expected to leak about ciphertext (public) but not key — fp-check decides security relevance

go.label: production
go.rationale: stdlib crypto/aes + crypto/cipher.NewGCM seal; varying 16-byte AES key. Real public AEAD API. Expected CT via AES-NI.

go.label: production
go.rationale: stdlib AES-128-GCM open with random ciphertext+tag (will fail auth); varying key. Tests Bleichenbacher-class failure-path leakage.

go.label: production
go.rationale: stdlib crypto/ed25519.Sign; varying 32-byte private seed. Real public signature API. Expected CT (SHA-512 + edwards25519 scalar mult).

go.label: production
go.rationale: stdlib crypto/ecdsa.SignASN1 on P-256; varying 32-byte private scalar. Real public signature API. Modern Go uses constant-time nistec.

rust.label: ct
rust.rationale: subtle crate, designed to be constant-time

rust.label: ct
rust.rationale: RustCrypto aes uses bit-sliced/AES-NI when available

rust.label: leaky
rust.rationale: PartialEq on byte arrays via std == — early exit

rust.label: microarch
rust.rationale: 256-entry table fits in L1; dudect cannot resolve sub-line cache effects

rust.label: production
rust.rationale: ring::aead::LessSafeKey::seal_in_place_append_tag with AES_128_GCM; varying 16-byte key. Real production AEAD API used by rustls.

rust.label: production
rust.rationale: ring::aead::LessSafeKey::open_in_place with bogus tag; varying key. Failure-path timing test.

rust.label: production
rust.rationale: ring::signature::Ed25519KeyPair::sign; varying 32-byte private seed. Production signature API.
